Accordingly, Mr. Yang has a material interest on both sides of the Transaction, and the Transaction constitutes a related party transaction. Mr. Yang fully disclosed to the Board the nature and extent of his interest in the Transaction. The issuance price of US$1.30 per Share was determined through negotiations among the parties, and the 4.875% equity interest in the Target Company was valued based on a valuation report of the Target Company provided by an unaffiliated third party.
